subject: Compiler containment and demonstrated fixes ready; stable host library 0f8d746c
body: Ready for review: mali_compute_compiler.c/h, mali_graphics_compiler.c/h plus new check_generic_texture_lowering.py, check_compute_texture_boundary.py, check_texture_source_matrix.py. No other production files changed; no native build/device actions. Stable host library gpu/build/mesa-build/src/panfrost/clc/libnord2_mali_runtime.so SHA256 0f8d746c3cc0a1bfb057c682bac5814c73dbfabccbb42e30fd88c6bbb37cc900. Final-hash regressions:58/58graphics cases,65/65compute-boundary cases; fullenum33sources x3phases,34ops,42actual compile-boundary refusals,10dimensions hostcompiled; existing10tile-fetch cases PASS. Evidence gpu/build/texture-lowering-audit/{fixed,compute-fixed,source-matrix,tile}/result.json. Actual QuartzCore graphics00073 now compiles VS3328/FS128; base_instance zero folded ONLY under existing TGJ1 instance1/base0 contract now documented. Actual accumulateKernel44d4ef32 now rc4 empty output with explicit texture ABI error, no abort. Array txf retains layer: emitted TEX_FETCH.array_enable now present, baseline absent. Pinned Mesa Grad+MinLod silently emitted TEX_SINGLE.computed_bias with gradients gone (gradient-minlod-baseline.log), now precise rejection pending faithful lowering. All rejected forms remain unsupported, not counted as implemented. Root owns commits/fullreplay lease. Compute worker must ACK versioned texture/image ABI before compiler enables resources; existing TGP1 buffer semantics preserved.
